findings.title: FallbackLocaleList inherits from Hash but only overrides []
findings.body: FallbackLocaleList extends Hash and overrides only []. Other Hash methods (keys, values, each, merge, empty?, etc.) inherited from Hash return empty-Hash behavior, which is inconsistent with [] returning a non-empty array for any locale. If any other code (including future changes or plugins) inspects I18n.fallbacks via these methods, it will get unexpected results. A plain object exposing only the methods actually used (or delegation) would be safer than inheriting from Hash.

findings.title: Translation cache key omits the fallback chain
findings.body: The translate cache key is "#{key}#{config.locale}#{config.backend.object_id}". It does not include the fallback chain used by I18n::Backend::Fallbacks. With localization fallbacks now in effect, a translation that is missing in config.locale will be resolved through FallbackLocaleList#[] (which incorporates SiteSetting.default_locale). If SiteSetting.default_locale changes at runtime (it is admin-editable), entries cached under the previous fallback chain will continue to be served for the new chain, returning stale translations. The cache key should incorporate the resolved fallback locales (e.g. I18n.fallbacks[config.locale]) so changes to default_locale or any other fallback source invalidate the relevant entries.
